decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Swampert. Lead Pelipper+Swampert sets Drizzle and Mega for Swift Swim EQ/Ice Punch T1 job. Back Archaludon (rain Electro Shot) + Gholdengo (GaG vs Whimsicott; Steel pressure on Meta/Altaria/Fairy). Hard answers Cloud Nine without needing endless rain.
decisions.notebook: Matchup: opp Cloud Nine Altaria, Prankster Whimsicott (Mental Herb), Mega Meta, Contrary Serperior sash, Rotom-W, Intimidate Arcanine Passho. Our plan rain core Mega Swampert+Peli+Arch+Gholdengo (GaG/Steel over Gyarados this game); Grimm screens vs physical. Electro Shot+Swift Swim pressure; Ice Punch 4x Altaria; EQ 2x Meta. Register: Peli DampRock Drizzle Modest HH/WB; Swampite Adamant EQ/Liq/IP; Arch LO Stamina Modest EShot; Ghold LO? Leftovers GaG Timid MIR/SB/NP; Grimm LC Prankster screens/FO/SB; Gyarados Sitrus Intim Jolly DD.

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Metagross. Whimsicott + Metagross establishes Tailwind or denies screens while Mega Metagross pressures Steel targets. Rotom-Wash covers Pelipper and Gyarados, while Focus Sash Serperior is the dedicated Mega Swampert answer and remains useful under rain.
decisions.notebook: Opponent has a rain core of Damp Rock Pelipper plus Mega Swampert, supported by Life Orb Archaludon. Preserve Serperior for Swampert and Rotom-Wash for Pelipper/Gyarados. Whimsicott Mental Herb Taunt is important against Grimmsnarl’s Light Clay screens; Mega Metagross is the preferred Mega in this matchup.

decisions.rationale: Rain up; Mega Swampert Swift Swim outspeeds. HH+Ice Punch aims to KO/chip Whimsicott through potential Tailwind setup before Meta pressures. EQ hits ally hard. Peli fragile to Meta.

decisions.rationale: Prankster Tailwind is guaranteed before Swampert, while Mega Protect denies Swampert's guaranteed Earthquake KO. This preserves Metagross and creates a Tailwind endgame where Rotom-Wash and Serperior can punish the rain core after Whimsicott is likely removed by Hurricane.
decisions.notebook: Opponent led Damp Rock Pelipper + Swampert rain. Mega Swampert Earthquake is a guaranteed KO on Mega Metagross even with spread reduction; Pelipper Hurricane is a guaranteed KO on Whimsicott. Prioritize Tailwind and preserve Mega Metagross with Protect; bring Rotom-Wash and Serperior to pressure the rain core.

decisions.rationale: Switch Rotom-Wash: Levitate avoids Swampert-Mega’s Earthquake, while Serperior is vulnerable to Pelipper Hurricane and is the stronger remaining answer to Swampert-Mega with Leaf Storm. Preserve Serperior’s Focus Sash for the endgame.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s rain lead is Damp Rock Pelipper plus Mega Swampert. Mega Swampert Earthquake KOs Mega Metagross even with spread reduction; Pelipper Hurricane KOs Whimsicott. Tailwind was established before Whimsicott fainted. Preserve Serperior’s Focus Sash and Leaf Storm pressure on Mega Swampert; Rotom-Wash’s Levitate is valuable against Earthquake.

decisions.rationale: Peli dies to any Electric; HH+EQ maximizes chip on Meta (46-93%) and possible Rotom KO under rain Swift Swim. Meta outspeeds even EQ; Protect Meta still lets EQ hit Rotom. Keep rain core pressure.

Swampert dies to Leaf Storm; must switch. Arch resists Grass 0.25 and Electric, gains Stamina, keeps rain Electro Shot pressure vs Meta/Rotom. Ghold also fine but Arch better immediate field presence.

Serp sash revealed; Meta Jolly MeteorMash/ST/BP/Protect; Rotom Modest Sitrus Tbolt/Hydro/Eweb/Protect.

decisions.rationale: Thunderbolt guarantees Pelipper’s KO if it does not Protect. Switching avoids the known Earthquake KO on Metagross; Rotom’s Levitate blocks Earthquake, while Serperior’s Focus Sash covers an Ice Punch and then threatens Swampert with Leaf Storm.

Serp outspeeds all and 4x OHKOes Swamp; sash already irrelevant at 58%. Arch Draco guarantees Serp KO; Swamp Protect blocks Leaf Storm. Sacrificing Swamp or leaving it open loses the rain sweeper for free. Electro Shot/FC do not secure the Serp KO.

Our plan rain core Mega Swampert+Peli+Arch+Gholdengo (GaG/Steel over Gyarados this game); Grimm screens vs physical. Electro Shot+Swift Swim pressure; Ice Punch 4x Altaria; EQ 2x Meta. Serp sash revealed (no longer full HP). Whimsicott lead Tailwind then dead. Prioritize removing Serp before Swamp takes Leaf Storm; Meta in back.

decisions.rationale: Use the final Tailwind turn to threaten both immediate KOs. Serperior is guaranteed before Swampert and Leaf Storm is 4x effective; Hydro Pump gains rain power into Archaludon. This denies their strongest attacking line if Hydro Pump connects, while Serperior’s Sash covers Ice Punch if they protect Archaludon.
Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Arch 34% dies to rain Hydro or ST; Protect lives. Swift Swim EQ before/after TW Meta hits both: 2x Meta chip + possible Rotom KO (Levitate false per chart). Next turn TW gone, rain Swampert dominates.

decisions.rationale: Protect denies Swampert’s Earthquake KO on Metagross while Rotom’s rain-boosted Hydro Pump has a guaranteed KO range on Swampert if it connects. The aggressive double-target line loses Metagross whenever Swampert is faster than Rotom, which is legal. Archaludon is weakened and at -2 Special Attack, so preserving both attackers is preferable.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Swamp 22% dies to almost any hit; Arch 34% dies to ST. Both Protect last turn so reduced odds—still best: Arch Protect, Swamp EQ. Meta takes 2x EQ (no Protect guaranteed); Rotom Levitates. Life Orb Arch needs spa recovery later via Ghold. Rain keeps Swamp outspeeding.
Only Gholdengo left; bring it into slot a opposite Rotom. Meta 23% dies to SB/MIR next; GaG blocks status.

Bullet Punch removes Swampert before its rain-boosted Swift Swim attack. Hydro Pump into Archaludon covers Swampert Protect and may finish its low remaining HP; if Archaludon Protects, Swampert still falls. This maximizes two-KO coverage while avoiding Metagross taking Earthquake.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s rain lead is Damp Rock Pelipper plus Mega Swampert. Mega Swampert Earthquake KOs Mega Metagross even with spread reduction; Pelipper Hurricane KOs Whimsicott. Tailwind was established before Whimsicott fainted. Preserve Serperior’s Focus Sash and Leaf Storm pressure on Mega Swampert; Rotom-Wash’s Levitate is valuable against Earthquake. Archaludon revealed Stamina and Life Orb, with Draco Meteor; it used Protect and can be pressured by Mega Metagross Stomping Tantrum. Mega Swampert carries Protect and may use it to deny rain-boosted Hydro Pump; Mega Metagross Bullet Punch is valuable priority cleanup.

decisions.rationale: Meta at 23%; SB is guaranteed KO (55-98% max). Outspeed Rotom always; Meta Spe 143-178 vs 149 is coin-flip. ST can OHKO if faster, but BP only chips and Protect is third use. Must remove Meta now to win 1v1 vs Rotom.
Protect prevents the immediate Shadow Ball KO while rain-boosted Hydro Pump puts Gholdengo into Stomping Tantrum range. Direct double-targeting loses too much to Protect; Thunderbolt is resisted.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s rain mode used Damp Rock Pelipper plus Mega Swampert; Swampert’s Earthquake KOs Mega Metagross and Rotom’s Levitate is key around it. Archaludon was Life Orb Stamina with Draco Meteor and Protect. Preserve Serperior’s Focus Sash where possible for Leaf Storm pressure into Swampert. Mega Metagross’s priority Bullet Punch remains useful cleanup; Stomping Tantrum is its meaningful Gholdengo coverage.

decisions.rationale: Meta at 23%; SB does 55-98% so KO if no Protect. ST/Hydro both OHKO us; Protect Meta likely after 3 uses (reduced). Must pressure Meta now before rain ends; MIR weak into both. Only Ghold left.

Stomping Tantrum is a guaranteed OHKO and Metagross is guaranteed faster, so it wins outright if Gholdengo attacks. Hydro Pump gives the strongest Rotom chip through a possible Protect, improving Rotom’s cleanup odds after Shadow Ball removes Metagross; Thunderbolt is safer but weaker.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s rain mode used Damp Rock Pelipper plus Mega Swampert; Swampert’s Earthquake KOs Mega Metagross while Rotom’s Levitate is key around it. Archaludon was Life Orb Stamina with Draco Meteor and Protect. Mega Metagross’s Stomping Tantrum cleanly threatens Gholdengo; preserve it from Shadow Ball when practical. Gholdengo has Protect, Shadow Ball, Make It Rain, and Nasty Plot with Leftovers.

reflections.summary: Lost because the rain Mega-Swampert+Arch EQ plan was a bad preview into their brought Rotom-W (Levitate) + Mega Meta: EQ was blanked, Hydro Pump repeatedly chunked Arch/Swampert, and healthy Rotom cleaned after Gholdengo only traded Meta.
reflections.adjustment: Change the bring vs Meta+Rotom—prefer Grimm screens and/or Intimidate Gyarados over full rain EQ, and do not lock Mega Swampert when Levitate Rotom is in; remove or pin Rotom before Swift Swim lines.
reflections.notebook: Matchup: opp Cloud Nine Altaria, Prankster Whimsicott (Mental Herb TWave/Taunt/Encore/Moonblast), Mega Meta Jolly MM/ST/BP/Protect (Protect-heavy; BP/ST), Contrary Serperior sash Leaf Storm/Dragon Pulse/Glare/Protect, Rotom-W Modest Sitrus Tbolt/Hydro/Eweb/Protect (Hydro spam; cleaner), Intimidate Arcanine Passho. G1 bring: Whims/Meta/Serp/Rotom (Altaria/Arcanine benched). Rain Mega Swampert+Peli+Arch+Gholdengo blanked by Rotom Levitate—avoid that preview; prefer Grimm screens vs physical Meta or Gyarados Intim; delay/deny Mega Swamp when Rotom+Meta likely; still Ice Punch 4x Altaria. Register: Peli DampRock Drizzle; Swampite Adamant EQ/Liq/IP; Arch LO Stamina EShot/FC/DM/Protect; Ghold LoG GaG MIR/SB/NP/Protect; Grimm LC screens; Gyarados Sitrus Intim DD.

reflections.summary: Won by leveraging Rotom-Wash’s Earthquake immunity and sustained Hydro Pump pressure to remove Swampert and Archaludon, while Mega Metagross kept Gholdengo in range. The four and Mega choice were broadly suitable for rain, though Metagross cannot be treated as a safe centerpiece into Swampert Earthquake plus Gholdengo Shadow Ball.
reflections.adjustment: Keep Rotom-Wash and Mega Metagross as the rain matchup core, but preserve Metagross until Swampert is controlled and avoid exposing Focus Sash Serperior to Archaludon’s Draco Meteor without protection or immediate payoff.
reflections.notebook: Opponent used Damp Rock Pelipper rain with Mega Swampert, Life Orb Stamina Archaludon, and Leftovers Gholdengo in game 1; Grimmsnarl and Gyarados were omitted. Swampert revealed Earthquake, Liquidation, Ice Punch, and Protect; Rotom-Wash’s Levitate is valuable against its Earthquake. Archaludon revealed Electro Shot, Flash Cannon, Draco Meteor, and Protect. Gholdengo revealed Make It Rain, Shadow Ball, Nasty Plot, and Protect. Future plan: retain Rotom-Wash pressure versus rain and preserve Mega Metagross for Gholdengo once Swampert is managed.
